title: The Bond as Evidence
narration_slice: merely bound wild dragons to specific families through blood-oaths, or worked deeper chimerical horrors in the volcanic dark. What history confirms beyond dispute is the result: a bond in which one rider claimed one living dragon—and the dragon accepted no other living rider while its master breathed.
filing_note: Batch 057 frames filed on disk under assets/batch_057/ and uploaded to Drive folder EP001_BATCH_057_IMG0561-0570 (1HhUVPcek11XTu-cihyohRuQR7bBJRodD); all ten checksums re-read from Drive and matched to the local files.
the_evidence_rule: **The bond as evidence, never as spectacle.** Chapter IV is the claim's register; The 19:00+ crossing dramatization (IMG0571+, still Chapter IV) is the staging register. Nothing in this batch renders the crossing — only the evidence for it: the binding object, the wearing of it by one body, the land that outlasted the question, and the one face in the batch — a dragon's eye at rest. No human figure appears in any frame.
hard_bans: face in any frame (the only face permitted is 0568's resting dragon eye — a detail study, not a portrait)
glowing script, sigils, runes or text anywhere
six-limbed dragons, third leg, fourth leg, arms, dangling feet
crouched wings-forward dragon pose (highest anatomy-risk configuration)
anything alight beyond a dull red-black vent glow that never touches figures
coursed masonry / ashlar / brick in any Valyrian structure (use the full fusion negation list)
drg_val_002: DRG-VAL-002 (First-Bound Mount): ~28-33 years, 65 ft length, 95 ft wingspan, rider CHAR-VAL-002 (never rendered). Burnished volcanic-bronze dorsal scales (#8C522B), dark ash-grey belly plates, twin metallic-bronze horns, three-ridged brow crest, molten copper-orange eyes (rendered dull and half-lidded — nothing glows). Riding fittings: heavy iron-and-leather neck straps over heat-cured ox-hide (no late-era saddle). Strictly 4-limbed.
anatomy_discipline: State the count numerically AND negatively in every frame with the animal; prefer flight with hind legs tucked out of sight, then pure silhouette, then side-on profile with both limb pairs visible. The 2x limb check is mandatory on 0561, 0564, 0565, 0566.
crop_checks_required: The only face in the batch is 0568 (dragon eye, CU) — verify it is a detail study, not a portrait, and that nothing glows.
0561: 2x limb check — exactly four limbs visible in side-on walking profile.
0564/0565/0566: 2x limb check — tucked-leg silhouettes, nothing dangles.
Paper/cord/leather with worked marks: none in this batch may carry any mark — check 0562 ring, 0567 grip-arc, 0569 oil-cloth at 5x for text, stamps, glyphs.
No coursed masonry anywhere — 0563's poured-shut archway and 0564/0566's caldera prisms get the full negation list and a 3x check.
inherited_lessons: 0528/0514/0482 fusion negation list (Valyrian stone poured, never coursed); 9b the caldera architecture ban (hexagonal prisms, uneven height, jagged tops — never a nave); DRG-VAL-001 countermeasures (flight/silhouette/explicit count); 6c panorama guard (one continuous exposure, no stitching); 0546 fire containment (0564's vent glow touches nothing); 0556 empty-bracket verification habit (0567/0569 objects verified at 5x); 0560 the collarbone crop (no human above any threshold — there are no humans).

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — the binding as a single strap, in motion
scenes.qc_note: MS 35mm tracking laterally beside one great dragon in a slow low walk, dim volcanic gallery, side-on profile: burnished volcanic-bronze dorsal scales, ash-grey belly plates, twin metallic-bronze horns swept back, three-ridged brow crest, eyes dark bronze with half-drawn lids — nothing glows. One broad ox-hide riding strap with dark iron fitting rides around the neck base, worn soft and pale along its belly edge, fitted for exactly one rider; no second strap, no saddle. **2x limb check: four limbs — two hind legs mid-stride, two forelimbs, no third leg, no fourth leg, no arms**; wings folded flat; no wings-forward pose. Hexagonal basalt prisms of uneven height, jagged tops, no capitals, no masonry; one dull red-black vent low and off-frame. No figures, no text. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — the oath as two objects
scenes.qc_note: MCU 65mm on a scrubbed stone slab: a plain hand-forged iron ring and the sinew-stitched end of a worn leather strap, side by side, dust in the seams; raking low lamp; hard shadows. **At 4x the iron carries no engraving, no maker's mark, no letter; the leather carries no stamp, no brand, no dye — nothing written anywhere.** No hands, no figures, no dragon. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — the branch of the claim nobody can testify to
scenes.qc_note: MS 50mm on an opening in POURED FUSED black stone melted shut from within — wrinkles, frozen drips, flaking fracture plates at the crown, one old crack re-fused by later heat still legible as a former opening; no door, no gate, no bars; swept empty threshold with a sediment-line seam of darker ash; high slot-daylight dying before the sill. **At 3x: no courses, no blocks, no joints, no mortar, no ashlar** — one cooled mass throughout. No figures, nothing alight, no symbols, no text. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — the dark the horrors are said to have happened in
scenes.qc_note: WS 35mm from a high ledge across a caldera of hexagonal basalt prisms of uneven height — no capitals, no drums, no masonry; against a dull red-black vent one dragon passes in far silhouette in flight. **2x limb check: tucked-leg silhouette — two hind legs tucked against the belly, out of sight; two wings; no third leg, no arms; nothing dangles.** Vent glow touches nothing; matte dry rock, no sheen; no figures, no fire, no text. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — the land that outlasted the question
scenes.qc_note: UWA 24mm from a high ridge under flat cold colourless overcast (First Daylight palette): bare cones with torn summits, smoke bent west, dry ash slopes, cypress and olive in the folds, the Summer Sea a hard cold turquoise band. One distant silhouette crosses high against the cloud. **2x limb check: tucked-leg silhouette, two wings, nothing dangles.** No town, road, wall or figure; no sun, shafts, moon or stars; one continuous exposure — no stitch seam. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — the dragon above, the claim below
scenes.qc_note: LAM 24mm straight up from the caldera gallery floor: sheer hexagonal basalt prisms of uneven height with jagged tops, vitrified obsidian shelves with sulfur crusts — no capitals, no plinths, the crown pure black. High between the pillars against the black, ONE dragon in flight, pure silhouette seen from below. **2x limb check: two hind legs tucked tight against the belly, out of sight; two wings spread fully; no third leg; nothing dangles.** One dull red-black vent glow low off-frame, touching nothing; no figures, no strap, no glow. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — the wear one hand leaves
scenes.qc_note: DET 85mm macro on the inner grip-arc of a hand-forged iron ring on dark ox-hide: one clean crescent of bright polished metal where a thumb and forefinger would seat after thousands of closing pulls — **at 5x the iron elsewhere is pitted and tarnished with no engraving, no stamp, no maker's mark; the leather carries no letter or glyph**. No body, no hand in frame. Matte dry surfaces. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up detail — the animal's resting eye, the whole of the relationship
scenes.qc_note: CU 85mm on ONE great eye at rest — long hooded vertically-slit bronze-copper iris under a three-ridged brow crest, lid half-drawn, dull burnished-bronze scales (#8C522B) with ash-grey dust in the seams; **the eye is matte and dark — no glow, no emission, no reflection of fire**; slight residual scale sheen under raking light noted and accepted as texture, not gloss. An anatomy detail study, not a portrait; the only face permitted in the batch. No text, no human, no strap. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up tactile / light study — the fitting nobody ever used
scenes.qc_note: DET 100mm on two objects on dark stone: **left** — a riding strap worn to old-tobacco softness, frayed stitching, its iron ring bright only at the inner grip-arc; **right** — an identical strap sealed inside its original oil-cloth, cord intact, leather beneath still dark with preserving oil, never opened. One low off-frame lamp; everything outside the two objects is black. No hands, no bodies, no text, no stamps. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Transitional wide horizon / bridge framing — the ledge before the morning
scenes.qc_note: WS 40mm from behind the high black basalt ledges above the Fourteen Flames, across the caldera toward the rim and open sky: black cones with torn smoking summits under flat even overcast, one thin white plume bent west, dry ash slopes, the first dull suggestion of open water on the far horizon. **The near ledge is a flat windswept black shelf — no figures, no dragon, no equipment, no fires, nothing laid out.** No sun, shafts, moon or stars; no town below. Two light sources (flat overcast; steam-grey plume). Approved first pass.

batch_057_close_note: CLOSED 10/10 on ten first passes — zero rejected generations, second consecutive Chapter IV batch with none. The batch holds the last clause of the claim ('what history confirms beyond dispute') without rendering the crossing itself: the bond appears as a single fitted strap (0561), as the tools of an oath (0562), as the poured-shut door of the untestable branch (0563), as distance and silhouette (0564/0565/0566), as one hand's wear on iron (0567), as a resting eye (0568 — the only face permitted in the batch, matte, dark, no glow), as the unused second fitting (0569), and as an empty ledge before the threshold (0570). 2x limb checks passed on 0561 (four limbs, side-on, no wings-forward pose) and 0564/0565/0566 (tucked-leg silhouettes, nothing dangles). 0563 at 3x shows poured fusion throughout — no courses, blocks or joints. 0567/0562 at 4x–5x: no engraving, no stamps, no text. Verified progress after this batch: 569/1,050 (54.19%).
